topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I didn't mean for it to end up like this. The attic was just a place to keep things out of sight, a spot where no one would bother them. Now, as you uncover these remnants, I can feel the weight of your gaze on me, even as I stand by, offering what explanations I can. Each item seems to whisper a secret, a choice I made, a decision I thought would keep the peace. I should have known they'd linger, these traces of our past life, now laid bare. I wish I could take back the decision to hide them away, but here they are, testament to choices not as temporary as I'd hoped.
